title: When do the AMLR and AMLA's customer due diligence standards apply? | Status tracker
summary: The AMLR applies from 10 July 2027. Where AMLA's CDD standards stand, when they could apply and what applies until then. Updated at each step.
body_markdown:
*Where the EU AML Regulation and AMLA's standards for customer due diligence and identity verification stand, what comes next and what applies in the meantime. Updated at each step.*


The EU AML Regulation (AMLR) applies from 10 July 2027. AMLA's standards on customer due diligence (CDD RTS) would apply 6 months after they enter into force, under Article 29 of AMLA's final draft. As of 25 November 2026, the European Commission has not adopted the draft, so the date of application is not yet known. Until 10 July 2027, customer due diligence obligations derive from national law, including the provisions transposing Directive (EU) 2015/849, as amended.


*Written by Aleksander Wasiak (Compliance Officer), Authologic.*
